desc: Prove rigorously the equivalence between the original pairing problem and selecting exactly \(2K\) labeled cakes with even counts for each label.
Develop an exact small-instance DP oracle and validate the baseline-plus-parity-repair structural theorem against exhaustive/random small instances.
Derive an efficient parity-correction algorithm from the unconstrained top-\(2K\) selection, including relabel operations and swaps with unselected cakes.
Establish a rigorous constant bound on retained transition candidates while enforcing distinct cake identities.
Design the final \(O(N\log N)\) implementation, with tie handling, 64-bit arithmetic, and edge cases.
